location.description: KVM location URI: kvm://[<host>]/[system|session]. Examples: kvm:///system, kvm://node1/system

connect_uri.description: Explicit libvirt connection URI passed to virsh -c (overrides the URI derived from location). Example: qemu+ssh://root@node1/system

ssh_user.description: SSH user for remote data access (reading/converting disk images on the hypervisor). Defaults to the user in the connection URI. Only used in remote mode.

ssh_port.description: SSH port for remote data access. Defaults to the port in the connection URI (or 22). Only used in remote mode.

domains.description: Comma-separated list of domain (VM) names to back up. Empty means all defined domains.

consistency.description: Consistency strategy: 'crash' reads live images (crash-consistent); 'fsfreeze' quiesces the guest via qemu-guest-agent then copies each disk (application-consistent, needs staging space); 'snapshot' takes an atomic external disk-only snapshot and streams the frozen base directly (no staging copy, guest frozen only for the snapshot instant).

overlay_dir.description: Directory (on the hypervisor) where external snapshot overlays are created in 'snapshot' mode. Must be writable by the QEMU/libvirt process.

tmp_dir.description: Directory (where the disk lives: local host or hypervisor) for the consistent qcow2 copy in 'fsfreeze' mode. Defaults to /var/tmp (disk-backed); avoid a tmpfs /tmp for large disks. Needs room for the largest disk's allocated data.

include_disks.description: Whether to include the VM disk images in the backup (in addition to the libvirt domain XML definition).
